mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_preferences ( id, user_id, preferred_generations, preferred_moods, preferred_artists, preferred_genres, preferred_video_types, excluded_genres, excluded_keywords ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{userId}, #{preferredGenerationsJson}, #{preferredMoodsJson}, #{preferredArtistsJson}, #{preferredGenresJson}, #{preferredVideoTypesJson}, #{excludedGenresJson}, #{excludedKeywordsJson} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE preferred_generations = VALUES(preferred_generations), preferred_moods = VALUES(preferred_moods), preferred_artists = VALUES(preferred_artists), preferred_genres = VALUES(preferred_genres), preferred_video_types = VALUES(preferred_video_types), excluded_genres = VALUES(excluded_genres), excluded_keywords = VALUES(excluded_keywords)
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, preferred_generations, preferred_moods, preferred_artists, preferred_genres, preferred_video_types, excluded_genres, excluded_keywords, created_at, updated_at FROM user_preferences WHERE user_id = #{userId}
